questions.q: Are worker bees male or female?
questions.fact: All female! Every worker bee is a girl. The male honeybees are called drones.

questions.q: What is a new worker bee's first job?
questions.fact: Cleaning cells! Young workers start by tidying up cells so the queen can lay eggs in them.

questions.q: What job do worker bees do last?
questions.fact: Foraging! The oldest workers fly out to collect nectar, pollen, and water for the hive.

questions.q: How long does a summer worker bee live?
questions.fact: About 6 weeks! Busy summer workers wear out fast, but winter bees can live for months.
